item.title: Pakistan's defense minister says that there is now 'open war' with Afghanistan after latest strikes
item.description: Pakistan's defense minister says his country has run out of "patience" and considers that there is now an "open war" with Afghanistan, after both countries launched strikes following an Afghan cross-border attack.

item.title: No. 12 Duke women secure share of ACC title by beating Florida State 80-52
item.description: Toby Fournier scored 22 points and grabbed 13 rebounds and 12th-ranked Duke broke it open after halftime and beat Florida State 80-52 on Thursday night to capture at least a share of the ACC regular season title.

item.title: O'Reilly scores late and Predators use 3 goals in the 3rd period to beat the Blackhawks 4-2
item.description: Ryan O'Reilly scored with 3:16 remaining and the Nashville Predators scored three times in the third period in a 4-2 win over the Chicago Blackhawks in the teams' first game following the Olympic break.

item.title: Achiuwa has career-high 29 points to lead the Kings past the Mavericks, 130-121
item.description: Precious Achiuwa had a career-high 29 points and added 12 rebounds, Maxime Raynaud scored 22 points and the Sacramento Kings beat the Dallas Mavericks 130-121 on Thursday night.

item.title: Grant's 27 points lift Trail Blazers past Bulls 121-112 as Chicago's skid hits 11
item.description: Jerami Grant scored 27 points and the Portland Trail Blazers held on for a 121-112 victory over Chicago that sent the Bulls to their 11th straight loss.

item.title: Ava Heiden scores 28 as No. 9 Iowa rallies past Illinois, 82-78
item.description: Ava Heiden scored a career-high 28 points and No. 9 Iowa overcame Illinois' second-half 3-point shooting to win 82-78.

item.title: Bey scores 42 points, Pelicans beat Jazz 129-118 to open 2-game set in Utah
item.description: Saddiq Bey scored 42 points, Zion Williamson had 20 and the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Utah Jazz 129-118 on Thursday night to open a two-game set.

item.title: Panamanian investigators remove documents from offices of company that ran canal ports
item.description: Panamanian investigators have carried documents out of offices belonging to a Hong Kong-owned company that operated ports at either end of the Panama Canal until its concession was declared unconstitutional by the Supreme Court last month.

item.title: Royce O'Neale hits last-second 3 to lift short-handed Suns over Lakers, 113-110
item.description: Royce O'Neale made a 3-pointer with 0.9 seconds remaining, Grayson Allen scored 28 points and the short-handed Phoenix Suns beat the Los Angeles Lakers 113-110 on Thursday night after blowing a late 12-point lead.

item.title: 4 years in, Ukraine has won by surviving
item.description: The Ukrainian people continue to endure unthinkable hardships.
